title: Metals struggle as economic growth concerns mount

summary:
Main
The energy sector posted gains, as attacks between US and Iran persist. Industrial metal struggled, as concerns over the global economy resurfaced. By Daniel Hynes

children.title: Chart of the Day
children.summary: The drawdown of US gasoline stockpiles raises the spectre of reaching critical levels in coming months. The lower bound of US gasoline inventories is considered to sit around 190mbbls.
